corrections.text: The article states the IAVI G004 trial "began dosing participants in January 2026." The cited IAVI press release states that the first doses were actually administered on December 15, 2025, at the Perinatal HIV Research Unit in Soweto, South Africa; January 6, 2026 is the date IAVI's press release announcing that milestone was published, not the dosing date itself. Dosing in IAVI G004 began in December 2025.

lji.org and iavi.org are not on the project's source_allowlist. Both are the actual primary research institutions behind this study (La Jolla Institute for Immunology, a nonprofit immunology research institute, and IAVI, a global nonprofit HIV vaccine research organization); all claims attributed to them were verified verbatim against their snapshots during review. Adding lji.org and iavi.org to config/source_allowlist.txt is recommended.
